prompt:
Transform the uploaded photograph into a 3:4 vertical diptych poster, divided horizontally into two equal-height sections.

Upper Half — Original Photography

Preserve the original photograph faithfully, maintaining its authentic photographic quality, composition, colors, lighting, and subject details. Do not add any text.

Lower Half — Japanese Retro Flat Illustration

Reinterpret the same scene in a Japanese retro flat illustration style, featuring thick, rounded black outlines, a limited color palette, and solid, flat color fills.

Behind the main subject, incorporate dense, sharply defined black-and-white screen-printed polka dots, with uniform size and consistent spacing.

Independently generate a meaningful 2–4-word English headline and complementary supporting text inspired by the visual content and atmosphere of the photograph. Use ultra-thin typography and an asymmetrical editorial layout. Avoid repetitive or predefined design templates.

The illustration, typography, and graphic symbols should collectively occupy approximately 70% of the lower section, leaving the remaining space as generous, intentional negative space.

Incorporate a moderate number of thematic graphic elements that complement the subject and strengthen the visual narrative.

Visual Aesthetic: Japanese vintage graphic design, retro editorial illustration, bold rounded contours, screen-printing aesthetics, minimalist composition, playful visual storytelling, and sophisticated typography.

Avoid: Award logos, gradients, 3D effects, excessive decoration, and generic template-based layouts.
